title: Explicit onsets, rates and the tail of the collision constant for heat-evolved Weyl polynomials
summary: Let $h_k$ be the orthonormal Hermite polynomials for the standard Gaussian weight, and let $a(w)=\sum_{j\ge0}a_jw^j$ be a real power series with radius of convergence greater than $1$, $a(0)\ne0$, no zeros on the unit circle and only simple zeros in the unit disk. For all large $n$ the polynomial $\sum_{j=0}^{n}a_jh_{n-j}$ has exactly as many nonreal zeros as $a$ has in the disk, but the known proof gives the onset by compactness.
